raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 27 txn_ids with two copies: a record_version 1 row and a record_version 2 row with a different amount. The silver filter keeps only status and not version, so when both copies are POSTED both survive and produce duplicate keys. Keeping the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, and leaving the raw data untouched, should resolve the duplicates and flow through to the gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
